parameters.name: BackupIds
parameters.description: The ID of the backup set that you want to delete. Separate multiple backup set IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb delete-backups --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --backup-ids 766,767 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
